div.span:
Column Family 't' (LDA Clusters):
• t:words (Top 6 topic terms JSON)
• t:count (Assigned document count)

Writer: Spark MLlib LDA (batch_job.py)
Reader: FastAPI /api/topics

Column Family 'a' (Daily Aggregates):
• a:pos (Positive post count)
• a:neg (Negative post count)
• a:neu (Neutral post count)

Writer: Spark Batch Job (batch_job.py)
Reader: FastAPI /api/history

Column Family 'd' (Data):
• d:id (Unique ID), d:source (Platform name)
• d:author (Handle), d:text (Original text)
• d:clean (Cleaned text), d:lang (ISO language)
• d:created_at (Event time), d:ingested_at (Ingest time)

Column Family 's' (Sentiment):
• s:label ('positive' / 'negative' / 'neutral')
• s:score (VADER compound score [-1.0, 1.0])

Column Family 'n' (NLP Features):
• n:hashtags (JSON array of #tags)
• n:keywords (JSON top 5 keywords)
• n:aspects (JSON aspect sentiments)

Column Family 'r':
• r:json (Original raw JSON payload)
• r:ingested (UTC ingestion timestamp)

Rowkey Salting Formula:
salt = CRC32(source | post_id) % 8 (Buckets: 00..07)
Prevents region hotspotting on high-velocity writes
